notes.title: Update and MacOS version release.
notes.content:
Today we have updated the Holy Sword RaveRanciel story and the Holy Sword RaveRanciel story + (plus) episodes.
In addition to lightening the operation, the UI has been updated to make it easier to operate with the game pad, keyboard and mouse than the mobile version.
We are adjusting the battle balance.

In addition, the release of the MacOS version has also been released.

The price goes up each time the additional episode is updated, so if you want to get a lower price, we recommend purchasing from this work.

As it is 820 yen (in Japanese yen) and $7.99 at the time of plus episode first episode addition, as it is scheduled to be added to the fifth episode, the price is finally thinking about 3000 yen and $25.00~$27.00.
If you purchased Plus Episode I episodes, you can purchase at the price currently displayed in the store, so if you are playing, please purchase early.

Thank you for your continued support for the Kurotsu Shirou Project and the Holy Sword RaveRanciel.
